title: Bizagi’s Summer 2026 Release Expands AI Insight, Automation and Control
markdown:
**July 21, WASHINGTON D.C.** – Bizagi, a leader in enterprise process automation and business orchestration, today announced its Summer 2026 platform release. The new version introduces capabilities that identify higher-value AI opportunities, respond to events in real time, gain smarter insights from data and extend the reach of AI agents across enterprise operations.

Key innovations in Bizagi Summer 2026:

- Real-time Kafka events: New Kafka integration enables organizations to send and receive messages in real time to react instantly to business events with scalable, resilient event-driven automation.
- Optimize your operations with AI: Get valuable recommendations and guidance to help identify, prioritize, and implement AI where it can provide the most business impact.
- Detailed visibility into AI usage and performance: This release brings comprehensive AI metric tracking and reporting capabilities, helping organizations track consumption and optimize their AI strategy.
- Embeddable charts and insights: Bizagi’s AI Assistant, Ask Ada, can now be embedded into business apps to present real-time and contextual views into business data, enabling users to have immediate access to reports and take action on the insights.

Together, the new capabilities in Bizagi’s Summer 2026 release create even more opportunities for organizations to orchestrate complex enterprise processes and deliver measurable business impact with AI.

To find out more about the key innovations in this release, join Director of Product Marketing Kevin Guerrero in tomorrow's live Bizagi Pulse session: [Bizagi Pulse \| Bizagi](https://www.bizagi.com/en/community/bizagi-pulse)

* * *

##### About Bizagi

Bizagi is an enterprise software company that enables business transformation. Its platform empowers users to create low-code apps with built-in AI that automate business processes. The intuitive and business-friendly technology boosts collaboration between business and IT, delivering faster results. Bizagi powers global brands, including DHL, Unilever, and BNP Paribas Cardif.
